_README: Executions whose results were superseded or that were aborted: real, billed project spend that belongs to NO configuration's cost (PI ruling D22, 2026-10-03: excluded from per-run and per-configuration costs, counted in the project total). The register never prices these; the project-total reconciliation (plan WP6) adds them. Figures are on the audited basis (scripts/lib_cost.price_usage over the meta's own usage); null where the execution left no meta. Append as more are found; never delete an entry. An entry found NOT to be separate spend moves to 'withdrawn' with its reason (it is kept, never deleted). Note that a run.meta.pre-rerun-N.json sidecar is not by itself a superseded execution: batch mode keeps its predecessor under that name, and a batch-recover leg's live meta already contains the predecessor's results (check the results file before listing one).

executions.kind: aborted attempt (a flex 503 storm); the pass was re-run
executions.evidence: 280,252 input (162,690 cached) / 884 output / 3,144 thinking tokens, 2026-09-01 07:10-08:42 UTC; 14 tiles processed, 1,384 failed. Separate executions from the run_N passes that replaced them (own run_id, a time window before run_N's, no resume), and outside every run_N directory, so the register never prices them and this entry does not double count. Tier: flex, by the run's driver logs (outputs/gemini37-image-gs-2026-09-01/{driver-k5.log, recovery-driver.log}) and the 2026-09-01 day export, which billed Gemini 3.7 Flash only at flex. Caution: reports/gemini37-image-55map-costing-2026-09-10.md line 19 describes its US$35.82 runner-estimate sum as including the fd-storm attempts; the run_* metas alone sum to US$35.8176 and with these four to US$35.9294, so that figure does not contain this spend. Corrected 2026-10-03 before merge: this entry first read 'no meta', which was wrong.
